Emoji Sentences

Read the sentence. Say the adjective for the emoji.

 

Sentence 1

Don't touch the pan. It is still .

 

Sentence 1

Don't touch the pan. It is still hot.

Similar words: warm (weaker), boiling (stronger)

 

Sentence 2

The little boy looked when his ice cream fell on the ground.

 

Sentence 2

The little boy looked sad when his ice cream fell on the ground.

Similar words: down (weaker), miserable (stronger)

 

Sentence 3

Our new puppy is very . She learned to sit in one day.

 

Sentence 3

Our new puppy is very smart. She learned to sit in one day.

Similar words: bright (about the same), sharp (about the same)

 

Sentence 4

There is a smell in the refrigerator. What is it?

 

Sentence 4

There is a strange smell in the refrigerator. What is it?

Similar words: odd (about the same), weird (about the same)

 

Sentence 5

My uncle tells stories at every family party.

 

Sentence 5

My uncle tells funny stories at every family party.

Similar words: humorous (about the same), comical (about the same)
